changeSet.author: shishir
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE "user" ( id INT8 NOT NULL GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, username VARCHAR(250) NULL, password VARCHAR(90) NULL, email VARCHAR(320) NULL, full_name VARCHAR(200) NULL, country_code VARCHAR(10) NULL, phone_number VARCHAR(10) NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, last_login_at TIMESTAMP NULL, account_enabled BOOL NOT NULL, account_locked BOOL NOT NULL, email_verified BOOL NOT NULL, term_policy_viewed BOOL NOT NULL, root_id INT8 NULL, registered_source VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'NONE', CONSTRAINT user_pkey PRIMARY KEY (ID), CONSTRAINT uk_user_username UNIQUE (USERNAME) );

changeSet.author: shishir
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE "role" ( id INT8 NOT NULL GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, "name" VARCHAR(60) NULL, CONSTRAINT role_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT uk_role_name UNIQUE ("name") );

changeSet.author: shishir
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE user_role ( user_id INT8 NOT NULL, role_id INT8 NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT user_role_pkey PRIMARY KEY (user_id, role_id), CONSTRAINT fk_ur_role FOREIGN KEY (role_id) REFERENCES "role" (id), CONSTRAINT fk_ur_user FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES "user" (id) );

changeSet.author: shishir
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE "refresh_tokens"( id INT8 NOT NULL GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, ref_token VARCHAR(250) NOT NULL, user_id INT8 NOT NULL, expired_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT ref_token_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id) );

changeSet.author: shishir
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE "forgot_password" ( id INT8 PRIMARY KEY GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, token VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, otp VARCHAR(10) NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, expiry_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, user_id INT8 NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES "user"(id) ON DELETE CASCADE );

changeSet.author: Furkhan
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE "email_verification_otp" ( id INT8 NOT NULL GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, user_id INT8 NOT NULL, otp VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, expires_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, verified BOOL NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
CONSTRAINT email_verification_otp_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT fk_email_verification_otp_user FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES "user"(id) ON DELETE CASCADE );

changeSet.author: Furkhan
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE "email_registration_otp" ( id INT8 NOT NULL GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, email VARCHAR(320) NOT NULL, otp VARCHAR(6) NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, expires_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, verified BOOL NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
CONSTRAINT email_registration_otp_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id) );

changeSet.author: Furkhan
changeSet.comment: Ensure one refresh token per user

changeSet.author: Furkhan
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE "subject" ( id INT8 NOT NULL GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL, code VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, description VARCHAR(500) NULL, active BOOL NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
CONSTRAINT subject_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT uk_subject_name UNIQUE (name), CONSTRAINT uk_subject_code UNIQUE (code) );

changeSet.author: Furkhan
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE "subject_faculty" ( subject_id INT8 NOT NULL, faculty_id INT8 NOT NULL,
CONSTRAINT subject_faculty_pkey PRIMARY KEY (subject_id, faculty_id),
CONSTRAINT fk_subject_faculty_subject FOREIGN KEY (subject_id) REFERENCES "subject" (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
CONSTRAINT fk_subject_faculty_user FOREIGN KEY (faculty_id) REFERENCES "user" (id) ON DELETE CASCADE );

changeSet.author: Furkhan
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE "academic_year" ( id INT8 NOT NULL GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, name VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, start_date DATE NOT NULL, end_date DATE NOT NULL, active BOOL NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
CONSTRAINT academic_year_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
CONSTRAINT uk_academic_year_name UNIQUE (name),
CONSTRAINT chk_academic_year_dates CHECK (end_date > start_date) );

changeSet.author: Furkhan
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE "grade" ( id INT8 NOT NULL GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, academic_year_id INT8 NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, description VARCHAR(500) NULL, active BOOL NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
CONSTRAINT grade_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
CONSTRAINT uk_grade_academic_year_name UNIQUE (academic_year_id, name),
CONSTRAINT fk_grade_academic_year FOREIGN KEY (academic_year_id) REFERENCES "academic_year" (id) ON DELETE CASCADE );

changeSet.author: Furkhan
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE "section" ( id INT8 NOT NULL GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, grade_id INT8 NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, description VARCHAR(500) NULL, active BOOL NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
CONSTRAINT section_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
CONSTRAINT uk_section_grade_name UNIQUE (grade_id, name),
CONSTRAINT fk_section_grade FOREIGN KEY (grade_id) REFERENCES "grade" (id) ON DELETE CASCADE );

changeSet.author: Furkhan
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE "student_enrollment" ( id INT8 NOT NULL GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, student_id INT8 NOT NULL, academic_year_id INT8 NOT NULL, grade_id INT8 NOT NULL, section_id INT8 NOT NULL, active BOOL NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
CONSTRAINT student_enrollment_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
CONSTRAINT fk_student_enrollment_student FOREIGN KEY (student_id) REFERENCES "user" (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
CONSTRAINT fk_student_enrollment_academic_year FOREIGN KEY (academic_year_id) REFERENCES "academic_year" (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
CONSTRAINT fk_student_enrollment_grade FOREIGN KEY (grade_id) REFERENCES "grade" (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
CONSTRAINT fk_student_enrollment_section FOREIGN KEY (section_id) REFERENCES "section" (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
CONSTRAINT uk_student_enrollment_year UNIQUE (student_id, academic_year_id) );
